exact: NAD biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of nicotinamide-adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) from vitamin B3 derivatives (including nicotinic acid (NA) and nicotinamide (NAM)), beta-nicotinamide D-ribonucleotide (NMN), nicotinamide riboside (NR) or nicotinate riboside (NAR), without de novo synthesis.
label: NAD+ biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway
